verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Missive is built for shared inboxes: multiple people work out of the same inbox without stepping on each other's toes, and conversations can be assigned to a team or person while staying visible to everyone. Supporting features include team inboxes covering everything from distribution lists to shared inboxes, shared-account settings, dedicated team spaces, collaborative composing and activity logs showing who did what. Community comments independently name Missive as a tool for collaboration, though they don't go into detail. Missing for 10: in-depth hands-on corroboration that every teammate sees the same conversation state in real time.
